notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura and Viridian Longbow attached to Malcolm.
Malcolm does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Malcolm by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Malcolm.
Repeat.
